source: prices.runescape.wiki OSRS RuneLite data via market_universe + cached catalyst_state
objective: Rank long-horizon, catalyst-backed GP parking opportunities separately from fast flips and evergreen mean reversion. Cash remains the benchmark and speculative positions are never mandatory.

portfolio_policy.rule: Speculative parks require an explicit catalyst thesis, bounded sizing, patient entry, invalidation and acceptable RuneLite freshness/liquidity. They do not enter the normal capital frontier while allocation_authoritative=false. Only forward-looking, corroborated catalysts belong in the active list; resolved pre-release bets must be archived and re-underwritten with live combat data.

top_candidates.name: Dragon hunter lance
top_candidates.thesis: The Spring 2027 Dungeons of Gielinor roadmap creates a future dragonbane discussion cycle. Not yet verified BIS; prefer patient entries and consider selling into announcement attention before launch.
top_candidates.invalidation: Encounter stats, monster classification, drops, profitable kill volume, or superior substitute weapons fail to support this combat style; sell-the-news or crowded community inventory swamps demand.

allocation_note: Suggested item sizing is a maximum percentage of liquid GP, not a target. Apply the lower of item and theme caps; leave the remainder in cash when entries are not met.
execution_rule: PARK_NOW requires fresh, non-crossed RuneLite prints. Crossed/asynchronous current prints are watch-only; staleish candidates may remain patient deep bids but not market buys.
